units.source_text: 源氏大将诵读《天台六十卷》，

en.t: General Genji recited the sixty volumes of the Tiantai scriptures.

units.source_text: 每有不懂之处，即请法师讲解。

en.t: Whenever he came to a passage he did not understand, he asked the priest to explain it.

units.source_text: 法师说：“这山寺平素积有修行功德，所以此次有此盛会，佛面上也是光彩的。”

en.t: The priest said, This mountain temple has long accumulated the merit of religious practice, and so this splendid gathering brings radiance even to the face of the Buddha.

units.source_text: 连下级的法师也都欢喜。

en.t: Even the lower-ranking priests were all delighted.

units.source_text: 源氏大将在山寺中悠闲度日，想起了俗世种种纠纷扰攘，竟懒得回家了。

en.t: General Genji passed his days leisurely at the mountain temple, and when he thought of all the disputes and turmoil of the secular world, he even lost the desire to go home.

units.source_text: 然而一想到紫姬，总觉得是一个羁绊，便不想久居山寺。

en.t: Yet whenever he thought of Lady Murasaki, he felt she was a bond tying him back, and so he did not wish to remain long at the mountain temple.

units.source_text: 临别之时，酬劳诵经费甚为丰盛。

en.t: When the time came to part, the payment for the sutra recitations was extremely generous.

units.source_text: 所有上下僧众，均得赏赐，连附近一切平民也都获得布施。

en.t: All the monks, high and low, received gifts, and even all the common people nearby were given alms.

units.source_text: 大大地做了一番功德，然后离去。

en.t: After performing a great act of merit, he departed.

units.source_text: 临去之时，山农野老聚集在各处路旁，都来送行。

en.t: As he was leaving, mountain farmers and elderly villagers gathered along the roads everywhere to see him off.

units.source_text: 众人仰望车驾，无不感激涕零。

en.t: Everyone looked up at his carriage, and all were moved to tears of gratitude.

units.source_text: 源氏大将身穿黑色丧服，乘坐黑色牛车，全无华丽之色。

en.t: General Genji wore black mourning clothes and rode in a black ox carriage, with no trace of splendor at all.

units.source_text: 但众人隔帘隐约窥见尊容，都叹为盖世无双。

en.t: But when the people caught a faint glimpse of his noble face through the blinds, they all exclaimed that he was unmatched in all the world.
